title: Digi FX Control
author: Digital Alchemy DSP
description: The DIGI FX and DIGI FOLD/EQ pages on the master page tree (FUNC+LFO), as the fourth and fifth entries. DIGI FX: RING (on, depth, frequency) and the level meter. DIGI FOLD/EQ: FOLD (on, amount) and EQ LOW / HIGH (each on/off + amount). Encoders A-H edit one parameter each, at the stock one-step-per-detent rate with acceleration (OS-style accumulation). Settings are stored per pattern inside the saved pattern data (they follow pattern switch / reload and a project save, like stock parameters). It drives digieq / digiring / digifold / digimeter (all required).
